question: A 5 kg block is moving with a velocity of 10 m/s on a horizontal surface. If a horizontal force of 20 N is applied to the block, determine the time taken for the block to travel a distance of 10 m.
A particle is moving in a circular path with a constant angular velocity of 5 rad/s. If the radius of the circular path is 2 m, what is the linear velocity of the particle?
A wave of frequency 100 Hz and wavelength 0.1 m is travelling through a medium. Determine the velocity of the wave.
A 50 kg object is moving with a velocity of 10 m/s on a horizontal surface. If a horizontal force of 20 N is applied to the block, determine the angular momentum of the block.
A 2 μC charge is moving at a velocity of 10^5 m/s in a magnetic field of 10^-6 T. Determine the force acting on the charge.
The refractive index of a given medium is 1.8. Determine the angle of incidence for which the angle of refraction is 25°.
The work done by a variable force F(x) in moving an object from x = 0 to x = b is given by W = ∫F(x)dx from 0 to b. Evaluate the work done if F(x) = 3x^2 + 2x + 1.
A particle of mass 0.1 kg is moving in a circular orbit with a radius of 0.1 m and a velocity of 0.1 m/s. Determine the centripetal force acting on the particle.
A particle of mass 0.5 kg is moving in a circular orbit with a radius of 0.1 m and a velocity of 0.5 m/s. Determine the centripetal acceleration of the particle.
A blackbody at a temperature of 800 K is emitting radiation at a frequency of 5 × 10^14 Hz. Determine the wavelength of the radiation.

A 100 Ω resistor is connected in series with a 20 μF capacitor and an inductor of 50 mH. If the circuit is connected to a 15 V AC source with a frequency of 100 Hz, determine the impedance of the circuit.
A 50 kg object is moving with a velocity of 10 m/s on a horizontal surface. If a horizontal force of 20 N is applied to the block, determine the potential energy of the block.

A 50 Ω resistor is connected in series with a 10 μF capacitor and an inductor of 20 mH. If the circuit is connected to a 15 V AC source with a frequency of 100 Hz, determine the phase angle of the circuit.
A wave of frequency 200 Hz and wavelength 0.05 m is travelling through a medium. Determine the velocity of the wave.
The refractive index of a given medium is 1.5. Determine the angle of incidence for which the angle of refraction is 30°.
